note: Uniforms (PLAN.md 1g c, user 2026-10-07): an outfit replaces a body's CLOTH surfaces (every VRoid material whose name ends in _CLOTH) with a flat material, keyed by the part in its name (Tops, Bottoms, Onepice, Accessory, Shoes; `cloth` = any other). A value is an [r, g, b] colour (sRGB 0..1) for a PLACEHOLDER flat material, or a res:// path to a material an artist made, which is used as it is. The forces that wear them are data too: crimes.json dispatch.bodies (police, by stars) and gangs.json gangs.<id>.bodies. character.Outfits applies them. Replace a placeholder by pointing its part at a .tres.
